title: 3.3.6d Lab — Two 3D instances
description: Create two Planet instances at different x positions to show that each instance is independent.

steps.title: Create p1 and p2 at different x positions
steps.instructions: In setup(), write `p1 = new Planet(-2, 0, 0, 0.7)` and `p2 = new Planet(2, 0, 0, 0.5)`. Give each a different color.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer on the right and look up the Planet class pattern from the reading.

requirements.title: Two Planet instances are created
requirements.description: Create at least two instances of Planet using new Planet(...).

requirements.title: Second Planet instance also created
requirements.description: A second new Planet(...) call must appear in the code.
